EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows strong aliphatic C–H stretches (2930/2964/2997 cm⁻¹; GFQ-003), prominent CH3 deformation bands (1437 and 1390 cm⁻¹; GFQ-003), a strong C–O stretch near 1079 cm⁻¹ characteristic of ethers, and a vinylic C=C stretch around 1677 cm⁻¹ consistent with an unsaturated cyclic acetal (1,3-dioxole). The intense band at 826 cm⁻¹ fits a ring breathing/COC deformation in a 1,3-dioxole, and 603 cm⁻¹ as an O–C–O bending/ring deformation. The weak band at 956 cm⁻¹ is consistent with a vinylic C–H wag. These features align best with CC1=C(C)OCO1 (candidate 1) over other options, which would require carbonyls (ester/acyl chloride) at higher frequencies or N–H features not observed.
